Set character limits and overlap, then read the chunks returned with the extraction result.

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/book_war_and_peace_1p.txt\"}")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"chunking\":{\"chunker_type\":\"text\",\"max_characters\":300,\"overlap\":40,\"trim\":true}}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].chunks)

asyncio.run(main())
```
